units.source_text: 于是顺次传杯，各赋诗歌。

en.t: Then they passed the cup around in order, and each composed a poem or song.
But everyone was drunk, and their words no longer formed coherent lines,

units.source_text: 未有胜于上述三首者，故不俱载。

en.t: none surpassed the three poems mentioned above, so the rest are not recorded here.
